# Convrt

> Convrt builds the AI Closer: an AI that sits inside a business's Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp, replies to every customer in seconds, in Arabic or English, and books them automatically, 24/7. More customers from the money a business already spends on ads. Convrt does not run ads. Based in Doha, Qatar. Part of Redstone Technology.

## What the AI Closer does
- Replies to Instagram DMs and comments, Facebook messages and WhatsApp in seconds, in Arabic or English.
- Qualifies each person (what they want, how serious they are) and moves the chat to a booking.
- Follows up when people go quiet, until they book or say no.
- Improves show rate: reminders before the appointment, a quick confirm, and an easy reschedule.
- Human in the loop: anything it is not sure about goes to the owner. It never guesses.
- Every lead and conversation is visible to the owner in one dashboard.
- Works alongside the business's team. It does not replace staff.

## How it is sold
- One-time setup (custom software development): Convrt builds it and connects the business's channels.
- The first month of maintenance and support is free.
- Then a monthly fee for software maintenance and support.

## Who it is for
Businesses anywhere that already run paid ads, such as clinics, gyms and fitness studios, real estate, education and training, and car businesses.

## Result
- A fitness business in Doha, first 30 days: more than 60% of incoming leads booked (up from effectively 0%), and new sales of more than 10x the ad spend in the same period.
